title: Gender stereotypes in dance education: a study of implicit biases and intervention strategies in the teaching process
core_idea: Investigate how gender stereotypes and implicit biases manifest in dance education and develop intervention strategies to address them in the teaching process, using a mixed-methods approach (surveys, interviews, classroom observations) and proposing a framework focused on reforming teaching philosophy, optimizing methods, and reconstructing evaluation systems.
tldr: Explores implicit gender biases in dance teaching and proposes a practical intervention framework (teaching philosophy, methods, evaluation) to promote more equitable pedagogy.
